text:
[LTIM.11.2] **A temporal value crosses the boundary typed.** A host or an
adapter must deliver a `Time`, a `Date` or a `Duration` into a slot of that
type ([NFCT.2.3], [LADP.4.2.1]), converting its source's form itself. The
engine reads no temporal text, and a `Json` slot carries no temporal value: text
inside a `Json` document is a `String` to a rule, whatever it spells
([LTIM.14]).

---
